grounding.from: Driving from Toronto to Montreal is about 540 km
takes roughly 5 hours 30 minutes without stops
mostly on Highway 401, per a route planner

value.answer: About 540 km, roughly 5 hours 30 minutes without stops. Most of it is on Highway 401, so add time for traffic, especially around Toronto and Kingston, and for any breaks.
